description:
A health informatics specialist needs to create a new concept map type to support terminology mapping between the hospital's local concept dictionary and ICD-11. The standard map types (SAME-AS, NARROWER-THAN, BROADER-THAN) are insufficient—a new 'ASSOCIATED-WITH' type is needed for loose clinical associations.

Your task: Create a new concept map type in the OpenMRS administration panel with the following details:

- Name: ASSOCIATED-WITH
- Description: Indicates that a concept is clinically associated with a concept in an external terminology system
- The map type should NOT be hidden

Steps:
1. Navigate to the OpenMRS administration page at https://localhost/openmrs/admin
2. In the Concept Dictionary section, click 'Manage Concept Map Types'
3. Add a new concept map type with the name and description above
4. Save the new concept map type

Login credentials if needed: username 'superman', password 'Admin123'.
